sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
CatBall's core gameplay revolves around shooting balls to break blocks, which may seem simple at first, but becomes increasingly challenging as the game progresses. With hundreds of balls bouncing and jumping around the screen, you'll need to quickly react and make precise shots to break the blocks and earn points. The game features various types of blocks, including basic blocks, bonus blocks, and power-up blocks, each with its own unique properties and point values.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter different types of blocks, each with its own breaking requirements. For instance, some blocks may require a specific number of hits or a specific ball type to break them. This adds an extra layer of complexity and strategy to the game, making it more engaging and challenging for experienced players. Moreover, the game's physics engine ensures that the balls behave realistically, adding to the overall sense of immersion and realism.

To break blocks, simply click on the ball you want to shoot using your mouse, keyboard, or touchpad. The ball will then bounce off and hit the nearest block, breaking it and earning you points. As you break blocks, you'll also earn power-ups and bonuses, which can be used to boost your score or provide temporary advantages. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, CatBall is an ideal choice for anyone looking to try out a new arcade game or relax with some casual gaming fun.
